questions.question: Choose the correct form of the verb in brackets to complete the sentence: She said that she [finish] her homework before dinner.
Select the correct reported speech form: He said, 'I am studying English.'
options: He said he was studying English.
He said he is studying English.
He said he had been studying English.
He said he would study English.
questions.answer: He said he was studying English.

questions.question: Identify the correct passive voice form: The report was written by the committee.
options: The committee was writing the report.
The report was being written by the committee.
The report has been written by the committee.
questions.answer: The report was being written by the committee.

questions.question: Choose the correct option to complete the sentence: If I _____ more time, I would travel around the world.
Select the correct reported speech form: 'What time do you leave?' she asked me.
options: She asked me what time I leave.
She asked me what time did I leave.
She asked me what time I was leaving.
She asked me what time do I leave.
questions.answer: She asked me what time I was leaving.

Which discourse marker correctly completes the sentence? _____ I'm sure you'll agree, this is the best solution.
Choose the most appropriate word to complete the sentence: The government has taken measures to _____ the spread of the virus.
